description:
PROBLEM
Anonymous registry pulls from shared GitHub runner IPs can hit Docker Hub or ECR rate limits (toomanyrequests). A service image that fails to pull fails its whole job, and the required checks aggregate those jobs. The Postgres service in sql-execution-evidence is owned by ci-sql-evidence-postgres-ecr-rate-limit-20261022 (PR #3455). This item covers every other anonymous pull in required jobs.

VERIFIED FACTS (origin/develop 121f24c2a, 2026-10-25)
- Required checks on develop: core, explorer, results-data, docs, tooling, hold, oracle-gate. Of the jobs feeding them, only these pull images: code-lint (shown as lint, ci.yml:599-608), whose service questdb/questdb:10.0.1@sha256:67eaed863ebb2383227919ea9a5499a4a39ceca3862c20b974c84a10e11cdf89 comes from Docker Hub anonymously, and sql-execution-evidence (ci.yml:1329-1337, ECR item). core needs code-lint (ci.yml:1569). explorer, results-data, docs, tooling (ci.yml:1678-1860) and hold (pr-hold.yml:16) pull no images. No ci.yml step runs docker pull, docker run or a docker:// action.
- The step 'SQLGlot repro retirement check' (ci.yml:634-640) uses the service through BENCHBOX_QUESTDB_DSN, its outcome is enforced by the step-outcome summary (ci.yml:857-862), and it runs every case on every run (scripts/check_sqlglot_repro_retirement.py:205-230).
- Digest sources: mirror.gcr.io/questdb/questdb@sha256:67eaed86...cdf89 answers anonymously with the same index digest (HTTP 200; Docker-Content-Digest and body SHA-256 equal the pin; checked 2026-10-25). ghcr.io/questdb/questdb holds only unrelated 1.0.x tags; public.ecr.aws has neither questdb/questdb nor docker/library/questdb. Moving the service to another anonymous registry does not remove the dependency, so mirror.gcr.io is used only as a seed source.
- The GHCR pattern already works with the job token: the org's private container packages cedardb, postgres, clickhouse and trino are linked to this repository; nightly.yml:424-427 and docker-integration.yml pull them with github.token credentials; mirror-ci-images.yml copies with --preserve-digests, tries ordered fallback sources (:98-101) and fails on any digest mismatch (:150-155).
- mirror-ci-images.yml installs skopeo with apt-get on every call (:26-29), so it must not run in the required PR path.
- Evidence check: of the 12 most recent failed ci.yml runs listed on 2026-10-25, one (run 40170713453) failed on toomanyrequests, and that was the ECR Postgres pull. No Docker Hub failure of the questdb pull is proven. This item is preventive hardening.

PLAN (no owner action)
1. PR A: add a questdb case to mirror-ci-images.yml with pinned source docker.io/questdb/questdb@<pin> and fallback mirror.gcr.io/questdb/questdb, and call it from nightly.yml (non-required; has workflow_dispatch) with packages: write. After merge, one dispatched or scheduled run seeds ghcr.io/benchbox-dev/questdb.
2. PR B, only after the seed exists and #3455 has merged: the lint job pulls ghcr.io/benchbox-dev/questdb@<pin> with service credentials (username github.actor, password github.token) and job permissions contents: read, packages: read. Extend the workflow pin test that #3455 adds so that ci.yml service images must be ghcr.io/benchbox-dev references pinned by digest.

DECISION GATES AND STOP CONDITIONS
G1 If the first push of the new package fails with 401, 403 or a package-creation policy error, stop: the owner must let the repository create the package, or seed it by hand. Never use a personal token.
G2 If every seed source rate-limits, stop and report the job log. Do not unpin, add unbounded retries, or point the service at an anonymous registry.
G3 If a fork or Dependabot PR cannot pull the private package with packages: read, stop and ask the owner whether to make ghcr.io/benchbox-dev/questdb public.
G4 Owner-gated fallback, only if G1 cannot be resolved: Docker Hub credentials on the service (services.questdb.credentials) from repository secrets that the owner creates. A login step runs too late for a service container, and forks get no secrets.
G5 Fork CI (BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot) stays out of scope unless the owner opts in.

GUARDRAILS
- Keep the digest sha256:67eaed863ebb2383227919ea9a5499a4a39ceca3862c20b974c84a10e11cdf89; never a tag. Keep the lint job otherwise unchanged; do not delete the QuestDB service or its check.
- Do not touch the Postgres image lines or mirror-postgres17 (ECR item).
- Minimal permissions; no new secrets without owner approval.
- Common: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, after make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. No SKIP or --no-verify, no stand-in approvals, no ruleset edits or bypasses, no raw gh pr merge. Do not change oracle-gate's App binding (integration 5201041), the oracle decision rule, or the native review-thread-resolution requirement. Do not close and reopen, mass-rerun or rebase other pull requests. No explanatory comments or docstrings in code; commits, PR bodies and docs carry no tracker item IDs or session labels.
